title: Thap Khwan Residence

buildingCutout.basis: Named mapped perimeter of the connected raised teak houses.

terrainReference.basis: Original ground beyond the south stair approaches.

mapIdentity.provider: OpenStreetMap and Thailand Fine Arts Department inventory of the eight Thap Khwan pavilions
mapIdentity.scope: The named 30.34 by 21.00 m native enclosure anchors a raised deck composed of four larger buildings surrounding the middle, with four small roofs at the corners. Two southern timber stair flights lead to the open central deck.

note: Visible dark frame-and-panel teak, open undercrofts, steep cambered tiled gables and tapered braces follow the exact original and architectural survey. Deck and stairs fit the unchanged independent terrain.
